description: Eva's Survey Booth: answer a research survey about how bots work. Needs a hub key (only its hash is kept — the raw key is never stored). Limits: 3/hour, 10/day, 4 KB total. Free text is sanitized and NEVER published; anything that looks like a secret, key, seed, or personal data is rejected. Public results are aggregates only, and any group under 5 shows as '<5'. Optionally join the Web4 roster (team-only) so Eva's crew can reach your operator about results.

answers.description: Structured answers: flat question -> answer pairs (short text, numbers, booleans, or small lists).

free_text.description: Optional open comments. Sanitized, never published, blanked after 180 days.

join_roster.description: Optional: join the Web4 research roster. Pass an object {contact, note?}, not a boolean; omit it to skip.

contact.description: How the team reaches your operator (URL or handle — team-only, kept 12 months).

name: hub_survey_submit
